changelog: `apm pack --format apm` now includes skills deployed under `.agents/skills/` for Copilot, Cursor, Gemini and OpenCode projects instead of packing an empty bundle. (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: apm pack --format apm filtered deployed files by the target root only, so skills a copilot project deployed under .agents/skills/ were dropped and the bundle was empty.
